text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — RC cutover in ~2h. Final code-freeze at 15:00 PT. If anyone needs a late-merge exception, post it here with PR link and risk summary. Tagging @Kevin O'Neill and @Sarah Patel for changelog + QA check. :warning:

Kevin O'Neill: Got a small version bump (minor semver) and a changelog entry ready, PR #5198. Changelog is updated in the PR, just needs a quick review.

Sarah Patel: QA: we need the Windows smoke to finish — currently 2 failing tests, working on it. If those don't pass we can't approve exceptions that touch runtime deps. ETA ~25m.

release-bot: Reminder — release freeze window: code-freeze starts 3487655400 (15:00 PT). Submit exception requests here before freeze or they will be blocked.

Eli Garcia: Requesting exception for PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5198 — bump telemetry-client 1.4.2 -> 1.4.3 (security patch). Risk: low, no API changes, unit tests + small integration smoke green locally. Patch touches only telemetry shims.

Anika Roy: Can we get a short risk mitigation plan? If it's only telemetry, we want a fallback on the feature flag if anything odd. Also require changelog line and release note.

Eli Garcia: Plan: feature-flag the telemetry call, add try/catch around the new client init, and add a `telemetry.v2` feature flag rollback. Commands I ran locally: ```bash
git checkout -b fix/telemetry-bump
make test && ./scripts/smoke.sh
``` All green for me.

Kevin O'Neill: I reviewed the changelog and it looks good. Please squash the tiny lint nit and I'll approve.

Sarah Patel: CI windows smoke just turned green (all tests passed). I can sign off on QA for this patch.

Anika Roy: Approving exception on condition of feature-flag and changelog present. Assigning to @Maya Chen for final sign-off. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. Final checklist: (1) squash lint nit (Eli), (2) ensure `telemetry.v2` feature flag is present, (3) PR approved by Kevin, (4) QA green (Sarah). If all met, I'll merge pre-freeze and cut the RC. Please post a short post-merge note here when merged.

Eli Garcia: Done — pushed squash + flag, PR updated and approved by Kevin. Merging now.

Maya Chen: Merged at 3487654598. Noted for the release notes. Proceeding with RC build. Thanks all. :rocket:
